semiconductor_relevance: High — Zen Voce specializes in the manufacturing and agency of equipment and materials specifically for semiconductors and related technologies.
summary: Zen Voce (Suzhou) Corporation is engaged in the manufacturing and agency of semiconductor equipment, including probe cards, test load boards, and burn-in sockets. The company also provides design and technical support for automated systems, catering to the needs of various industries within the semiconductor sector.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Suzhou, China, focusing on the semiconductor equipment market.
